immutable_design.objective: Prospectively test whether early, score-derived router updates forecast later persistent recovery and whether recovery-time scaling changes with active-face leakage.

model_and_data_lock.data_source: checksum-verified full balanced AG News corpus for the no-drop and capacity recovery experiments

cohorts.cohort_gate: Run only after the no-drop integrity, entry, logging-completeness, and forecast-freeze checks pass; no-drop outcomes may not change capacity-limited endpoints or analysis.

branch_definitions.free_release: Remove the suppression clamp at the fork and apply unmodified training updates.
branch_definitions.continued_suppression_context_reference: Retain the legacy target-below-comparator constraint only as a context reference; do not interpret it as a neutral causal control.
branch_definitions.zero_advantage_gradient_projection_refer: Remove the clamp, then project the target-versus-comparator component of the router-logit gradient to zero on the selected evaluation domain before the router optimizer update; leave common-mode router gradients, experts, nonselected logits, optimizer state, future batches, and all other parameters matched.

integrity_rules: The three branches share the same forked model, optimizer, and future-batch fingerprints within each seed, layer, and initial-mass cell.
Realized logit updates are measured from parameters before and after the optimizer step, not inferred from the learning rate.
Pre-top-k probabilities and post-dispatch traffic are logged separately.
Capacity runs satisfy total_assignments = kept_assignments + dropped_assignments at every logged step.
Layers and mass cells are repeated measurements; the seed remains the inferential unit.

forecast_rule.information_allowed: Initial mass and realized router-gradient/update logs through step 256 only.
forecast_rule.prediction: Extrapolate the seed-layer cumulative realized log-odds update advantage from the first 256 steps to a prespecified budget-crossing time; declare no crossing when the estimated slope is nonpositive.
forecast_rule.primary_endpoint: Within-seed mean absolute error between forecast and censored persistent-recovery time across prescribed layers and initial-mass cells.
forecast_rule.secondary_endpoint: Within-seed fraction of future persistent-recovery outcomes correctly classified at the frozen forecast time.

mechanism_contrasts.primary: free_release minus zero_advantage_gradient_projection_reference on within-seed forecast error and restricted persistent-recovery time
mechanism_contrasts.capacity_policy: Analyze cohorts separately; do not compare no-drop and capacity-limited effect magnitudes as a capacity benefit.
mechanism_contrasts.multiplicity: One primary mechanism contrast per cohort; secondary layer and mass results are descriptive with seed-clustered summaries.

mass_scaling_analysis.seed_level_response: Within each seed and branch, average censored recovery times across prescribed middle layers at each initial-mass target.
mass_scaling_analysis.leakage_classification: Classify a cell from the pre-outcome first-256-step active-face leakage log, using a threshold fixed before launch.
mass_scaling_analysis.comparison: Report leave-one-seed-out prediction error for the two clocks separately within the prespecified leakage classes.
mass_scaling_analysis.restriction: Do not claim inverse-mass or logarithmic scaling unless the corresponding leakage hypotheses and entry checks pass.

exclude_only_for: missing required gradient or optimizer-update logs
stopping_and_exclusion.outcome_blind_replacement: A failed seed may be replaced only before any post-fork outcome is read, using the next consecutive seed and a recorded reason.
